settings.html: Our financing partner

settings.editor: We've partnered with Synchrony Bank, one of the nation's largest and most established consumer financing providers, to give our customers safe, flexible payment options. Your application is handled securely, and pre-approval won't take more than a few minutes.
Financing pairs well with our other ways to save. Ask about current equipment specials and rebates, and keep your new system protected with a Lenz HVAC maintenance plan.

settings.html:
You can apply online through Synchrony Bank in just a few minutes, or in person during your free in-home estimate. Our team can walk you through the options and answer questions before you apply.

Yes. We offer promotional 0% deferred interest financing for qualified buyers on new system installations. Promotional terms vary, so call us at (515) 225-6446 for the current offer. Subject to credit approval.

Pre-approval typically takes only a few minutes. You'll know your options quickly so you can move forward with your installation without a long wait.

Financing can be used for new furnaces, air conditioners, heat pumps, water heaters, indoor air quality systems, and full system replacements. Ask our team about financing any major home comfort upgrade.

Financing is provided through Synchrony Bank, a trusted national lender. Lenz Heating & Cooling is not a lender; all financing is subject to Synchrony's credit approval and terms.

Not at all. Financing is simply an option to make larger investments easier. You're always welcome to pay by your preferred method, and we provide free, no-obligation estimates either way.
